set.body:
Outcome
Honor motion preferences in custom timers as well as native transitions.

Owned scope
DockRegion.scala indicator timer; views.scala tab slide/divider feedback; generic presentation API and tests

Prerequisites
S4

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Provide generic motion policy with runtime changes and a documented host/OS-preference bridge that remains compatible with the library floor.
- [ ] Reduced motion immediately settles indicator glides/tab slides and nonessential fades; custom AnimationTimer execution stops when settled, hidden or disposed.
- [ ] Keep immediate drag-follow and clear drop-target feedback; cancellation leaves no running timer, stale indicator or cursor.
- [ ] Test switching policy mid-animation, during density/theme changes and while closing a floating owner.
- [ ] Default-motion behavior remains intentional and bounded; implementation does not rely solely on JavaFX27 release-note guarantees.

Required evidence
Timer/lifecycle assertions, reduced/full-motion native traces and drag-cancellation regressions on floor/27 lanes.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
../meridianfx/PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code S5. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [S5] Add explicit reduced-motion behavior for custom docking animations
